name: ecoinvent-biosphere3__bafu-2026-v1-speciation-candidates
description: Speciation-changing mapping candidates (NOT applied as replace): ionic-form or oxidation-state notation differs between source and target. Proposed resolution: extend the BAFU biosphere with speciated flows. Includes one resource-reclassification candidate (graphite ore).
